top_signals.title: Long-Term Treasuries Rise Ahead of Key US Inflation Report
top_signals.summary: Long-term Treasuries advanced as traders focused on the potential that Wednesday’s release of US consumer prices data will reinforce expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate increase.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: A unique vantage point − speech by Nathanaël Benjamin
top_signals.summary: Given at the ISDA Derivatives Trading and Treasury Forum
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Jaishankar: India-US Trade Talks Heading in Right Direction
top_signals.summary: Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar told Bloomberg Editor-in-Chief John Micklethwait that trade negotiations with the US were close to a conclusion, though final details remained to be resolved. They spoke at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
